title: Vertical Ratio
claims: Garmin defines vertical ratio as vertical oscillation divided by stride length, expressed as a percentage.
Garmin describes a low vertical ratio as a small energy cost for a large horizontal benefit, which it interprets as more efficient running.
This page gives no threshold value for vertical ratio.

claimVerification.note: "Vertical ratio is the amount of bounce in your stride, divided by your stride length, then expressed as a percent."
"A low vertical ratio number indicates a small cost for a large benefit. That means more efficient running."
页面只有定义与解释，没有阈值；不能从“本页未给阈值”外推为“Garmin 不发布阈值”。
